name: emf-to-png
description: WASM-based EMF/WMF → PNG (or JPEG) converter for Node.js. No Office/LibreOffice/Inkscape required.

scripts.clean: rimraf dist wasm\emf2svg.wasm wasm\emf2svg.js wasm\wmf2svg.wasm wasm\wmf2svg.js && powershell -NoProfile -Command "Remove-Item -Recurse -Force .work-* -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue"
scripts.build:wasm: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/build-wasm.emf.ps1 ; powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/build-wasm.wmf.ps1
scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:js && node scripts/postbuild-copy-wasm.mjs
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build && npm test
